channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's curated vulnerabilities reveal a high-severity threat environment characterized by widespread remote code execution and authentication bypass flaws, particularly impacting Oracle enterprise software including E-Business Suite, WebLogic, and MySQL alongside critical network appliances from Citrix and pfSense. Industrial control and IoT sectors face significant danger from buffer overflows and command injection vulnerabilities in devices from vendors such as Philips, Cudy, and DJI, while cloud and AI workloads are exposed through unsafe deserialization and malicious model parsing risks in platforms like Arize AI and llama.cpp. Additional notable threats target mobile and desktop users via Samsung device management weaknesses and parser flaws in applications like AutoCAD and VirtualBox, emphasizing the pervasive nature of memory corruption and configuration errors across diverse technology stacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-100967 — Other
item.description: Deserialization of untrusted data in NVIDIA Megatron-LM enables code execution and data tampering, threatening AI model training pipelines and integrity.

item.title: CVE-2026-127031 — Other
item.description: Eclipse AAS4J validates untrusted XML with JAXP resolving external DTDs and entities, enabling SSRF or local file reads via crafted AAS packages.

item.title: CVE-2026-130290 — Other
item.description: Open Object Rexx RXAPI blindly trusts client-provided message sizes, causing heap buffer over-reads that can leak sensitive memory or crash applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-126402 — Other
item.description: Fleetdm's user administration API incorrectly authorizes team administrators to grant admin roles on unrelated teams, violating least-privilege principles and enabling lateral privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2026-103663 — Other
item.description: Ollama's /api/pull endpoint lacks proper path validation, allowing attackers to traverse directories and drop malicious binaries outside the model storage.

item.title: CVE-2026-111760 — Other
item.description: Git versions prior to 2.50.2 are vulnerable to repository manipulation where an attacker-controlled host can execute arbitrary commands during fetch operations.
